reviews.comment: Easiest professor ever. You don't need to go to class, just attend ta review sessions. Exams are easy and fair if you attend review sessions.

He was hard to understand and his slides are just pictures. The TA review sessions are the only thing that allowed people to suceed. Li was horrible so please dont take him. this was the only B i have had in my life and I know for a fact that with a different prof I would have gotten an A. Also, he allows a cheat sheet for exams that dont help.

Accent is not too difficult to understand. Lecture material doesn't really help on exams and even with cheat sheets it's hard to do well. He's a sweet guy and genuinely likes student interaction but I do not feel prepared well for biochem 2 with this class. Gives extra credit for attendance but I have no clue how much it counts for

I have immigrant parents, so to say I had a very hard time understanding him says a lot. Sucks because he is a nice person but an awful teacher. Can tell he is super passionate but that wont get you far. Cant lie you really do either study the right things or don't. He now has multiple choice and a cheat sheet but still hard. Good luck.

Avoid at all costs. Is possibly worse than Miles, which is saying a lot. He has a very heavy accent which is pretty hard to understand, doesn't lecture well and stops the class completely when somebody is on their phone. He only seems to care about his research. The only positive is that he starts to give out extra credit when attendance drops.

Do not take him if you don't have to!!! Lectures don't help. He posts slides with little to no words on them. Hard to understand. Our TA Matt was the only way I passed because he had 1 hour review sessions a few days before the test to attempt to reteach everything. Take anyone else!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A-plus tutoring is the only reason I passed this class. Homework and quiz grades kind of act as a grade buffer, but exams are either lecture based or textbook based and theres no way to know beforehand.

This class is all luck. Either you studied the right quizlets or not. He also likes to tell you to "Google it" when you have a genuine question about the material. Probably the worst professor I've ever had and does nothing to help his students whatsoever.

Lectures are not beneficial to understanding the material. Slides are not helpful as they are all pictures. Exams are online but must be taken in person. I will be retaking this class but not with Li. Everything I did manage to learn was from a friend with a different prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is the worst professor Ive ever had. Ive never had a class where going to lecture did so little for my understanding of the concepts before this. However, he gives extra credit for attending class (or else no one would attend). I had cancer and this class was harder than that. Be prepared to teach yourself the most complicated topics ever.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: only reads off slides, cant really understand him, doesnt rlly answer questions
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures do not relate to what you need to know so students stopped showing up to class. He got fed up and started offering bonus points for attendance. His exams are extremely hard as they require you to know random unimportant facts from the textbook rather than making it about actual concepts. He is nice but did not learn a thing.

I have never been so close to getting a C in my life. He's a terrible professor. He gives the basics on the material and expects you to know everything about the things he teaches about. Stay away from this professor, care more about research and doesn't put much work into teaching.
didn't curve my 89.67 to an A. He was super rude about it and was not understanding at all. If you are looking for a prof that will actually care, don't take Li.

Dr. Li might not be the "best" prof that helps you in the long run but he's definitely NOT a difficult professor to get by. His exams are free-response which can be both good and bad. STUDY HIS HOMEWORK AND QUIZ PROBLEMS BEFORE EXAMS. KNOW EVERY STRUCTURE. And SHOW UP TO CLASS! He tends to give out random extra credit for attendance on random days

You can tell that Dr. Li really cares about biochemistry, but he is not the best with lectures. You get the general idea from his lectures, but you really have to teach yourself to actually do well on the tests. His review topics for tests are key to doing well on the tests.

Dr. Li cares about his students and loves biochem. Bad at answering questions. Great prof to take if you're interested in his research. Tells you what you need to know but you will be teaching it to yourself later. Exam topic lists are your friend. Tests are race against time but doable. Extra credit for showing up. DON'T use cell phone in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: BICH410 is a difficult class but Dr. Li is not a bad professor. Clear grading criteria. Significant extra credit for attendance. Has an accent but still easy to understand. Sincerely cares about his students & passionate about biochemistry. Exams are a race against time & very tough. Stickler about no cell phones during lecture.

This man does not know how to teach. His lectures are absolutely pointless and I am teaching every single thing to myself. The funniest part is that he gets mad when people start leaving in the middle of the lecture like man your lecture is the most useless thing ever what do you expect?

Does not teach, flat out and simply put. Simply tells you what you need to know, will assign homework and tell you that you must know how to do it, but will not show you how. I do not understand his logic. I did not learn a single thing from him directly. I have taught myself everything in this class. Horrible professor, if you can call him that?
TERRIBLE! EVEN MILES IS BETTER THAN HIM
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class itself was difficult. Dr, Li randomly gives extra points to those present. Do not neglect your homework and quizzes ( each point is worth it) Go at the Review session for exams. The final exam was the easiest one for me.

Dr. Li is a very nice man, but oh lord was this class hard. Most tests you're working against the clock, but they are relatively fair regarding content. He gives out extra credit for attending class and it is SUBSTANTIAL. If you work hard and attend lecture the class is hard but very doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Our class average is decent, but that is no thanks to this professor. His lectures are useless and my grade in the class is thanks to what I taught myself, and the TA I ended up getting. Definitely avoid this professor if possible. Also he no longer provides practice tests. Just quizzes in recitation and homework.

You should go to lectures even though you won't be able to understand half of what he says. He gives practice tests and quizzes that are nothing like the exams. The exams are super long and barely anybody finishes them. I would take another professor.

Going to lecture is pointless, you will learn nothing and won't understand anything he says. The test are hard and long, although he does provide a practice test. Recitation hw and quizzes are pretty easy and you will need to do well on them to help your grade. He is also super rude outside of class.
Can't understand him,heavy accent. Not helpful, outside class. Recitation is easy however. Tests are hard, although he does provide practice tests that are similar.
